purpose: compare declared reported spans without extending them to full calendar cycles
flow_scope: reported_summary_coverage; require exact CVG_START_DT and CVG_END_DT match
outside_reported_span: preserve exact prefix/suffix dates and day counts; activity and money unknown
internal_coverage: require existing field-window readiness; envelope dates do not bridge internal gaps
first_report: earliest observed report, registration date, amendment N and equal values do not establish inactivity
cumulative_columns: candidate election-cycle-to-date and PAC/party calendar-year-to-date are not two-calendar-year bulk period substitutes
field_conflicts: unchanged v1 checks; retain all assertions and members
